<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tame Hound 16</title>
<style>
/* Tame Hound 16 by absoluteSTrange — https://uiverse.io/absoluteSTrange/tame-hound-16 */
button {
 padding: 17px 40px;
 border-radius: 10px;
 border: 0;
 background-color: rgb(255, 56, 86);
 letter-spacing: 1.5px;
 font-size: 15px;
 transition: all .3s ease;
 box-shadow: rgb(201, 46, 70) 0px 10px 0px 0px;
 color: hsl(0, 0%, 100%);
}

button:hover {
 box-shadow: rgb(201, 46, 70) 0px 7px 0px 0px;
}

button:active {
 background-color: rgb(255, 56, 86);

 box-shadow: rgb(201, 46, 70) 0px 0px 0px 0px;
 transform: translateY(5px);
 transition: 200ms;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>
